map.按默认参数（可燃物 500 kg、平均热值 20 MJ/kg、房间 100 m²: With default parameters (500 kg combustibles, average calorific value 20 MJ/kg, room 100 m²): total heat = 500 × 20 = 10000 MJ; fire load density = 10000/100 = 100 MJ/m²; converted at a wood calorific value of 18 MJ/kg, the equivalent wood load = 100/18 ≈ 5.6 kg/m², rated as a low load level. For comparison, ordinary offices are often 300~500 MJ/m², and book stacks and warehouses can exceed 1000 MJ/m².
